import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR']); t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows): G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
# print demo 3 input and output side by side, then diff cells
I,O=G['Demo pair 3 input'],G['Demo pair 3 output']
def show(g): 
    for r in g: print(''.join(str(x) if x!=1 else '.' for x in r))
    print()
show(I); show(O)
diffs=[(i,j,I[i][j],O[i][j]) for i in range(len(I)) for j in range(len(I[0])) if I[i][j]!=O[i][j]]
print('n_diff',len(diffs)); [print(d) for d in diffs]

def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    for c,p in comps2(g):
        rs=[a for a,b in p]; cs=[b for a,b in p]
        mr=sum(rs)/len(rs); mc=sum(cs)/len(cs)
        # missing corner: the 2x2 bbox cell not in shape
        miss=[(a,b) for a in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1) for b in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1) if (a,b) not in set(p)]
        assert len(miss)==1
        m=miss[0]
        dirs=[]
        for dy,dx in ((1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)):
            if (m[0]+dy,m[1]+dx)==p[0] if False else None: pass
        # away dir: diagonal unit whose first step is NOT into the shape and points away from centroid
        best=None
        for dy,dx in ((1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)):
            n=(m[0]+dy,m[1]+dx)
            if n in set(p): continue
            v=((m[0]-mr)*dy+(m[1]-mc)*dx)
            if best is None or v>best[1]: best=(v,(dy,dx))
        dy,dx=best[1]
        y,x=m[0]+dy,m[1]+dx
        while 0<=y<H and 0<=x<W:
            g[y][x]=c
            y+=dy; x+=dx
    return g
